blockingCauses.behavioralInvariant: The candidate changes observable behavior for an omitted externally-deserialized property. Restore baseline-equivalent behavior for all four cases: when the property is ABSENT, the candidate must observably behave the same as the baseline default; when the property is EXPLICIT NULL, preserve the baseline’s explicit-null behavior; when the property carries an EXPLICIT VALUE, preserve the baseline’s explicit-value behavior; when the value is INVALID, preserve the baseline’s applicable rejection behavior. Do not restrict the fix to a single hardcoded literal or line — select whichever implementation genuinely restores this invariant for the candidate’s own type.

independentReview.finding: TaskDTO.statusPresent field added with @JsonIgnore annotation to track explicit presence of status in JSON payload
evidence: Field is private boolean statusPresent with no persistence annotations
@JsonIgnore annotation prevents serialization to JSON responses
setStatus() method sets statusPresent=true when invoked by Jackson deserializer
Default constructor leaves statusPresent=false for absent properties
All-args constructor sets statusPresent=true for programmatic construction

independentReview.finding: TaskDTO.isStatusPresent() getter added with @JsonIgnore to expose presence flag to service layer
evidence: Method is public boolean isStatusPresent()
@JsonIgnore annotation prevents inclusion in JSON serialization
Returns the statusPresent field value
No persistence entity references or imports

independentReview.finding: TaskService.updateTask(Long, TaskDTO) modified to conditionally update status based on presence flag
evidence: Baseline behavior: absent status field leaves existing task status untouched
Candidate behavior: checks isStatusPresent() before calling parseStatus()
When statusPresent=false, existing.setStatus() is not called, preserving current status
When statusPresent=true and status=null, parseStatus(null) returns null, preserving explicit-null semantics
When statusPresent=true and status!=null, parseStatus() validates and converts, maintaining BAD_REQUEST on invalid values
User relationship is not modified (PRESERVE requirement met)
createTask(TaskDTO) remains unchanged with its existing null-check

independentReview.finding: TaskService.updateTask(Long, TaskDTO) preserves title, description, priority, and updatedAt handling
evidence: Title update: existing.setTitle(updatedTask.getTitle()) unchanged from baseline
Description update: existing.setDescription(updatedTask.getDescription()) unchanged from baseline
Priority update: existing.setPriority(updatedTask.getPriority()) unchanged from baseline
UpdatedAt: existing.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now()) unchanged from baseline
No relationship modifications to user field

Preserves type-safe enum conversion via Task.TaskStatus.valueOf()
